message:
The other day, I found myself in a situation that truly made me appreciate the value of being prepared. My granddaughter was visiting, and as we were playing in the yard, a sudden downpour caught us off guard. While we dashed for cover, I remembered the little go-bag I'd tucked away in the closet—a habit I started after hearing a friend share her own preparedness story. We grabbed it and found a couple of umbrellas, some snacks, and even a flashlight. 

It felt good to be the one with a plan, for once! We huddled under the porch, laughing and nibbling on treats while the rain danced around us. It’s funny how a little bit of readiness can turn a surprise into a sweet memory. Have you ever found yourself unexpectedly grateful for being prepared?
